_doc: GENERATED by `python3 godot/tools/music_direction.py brief` from direction.json, the catalog and every scene — never hand-edit. Per catalog track: the scenes the MusicDirector plays it in (assuming every track has audio), why (cue / bgm / leitmotif / locale / chapter), the intensity those scenes drive (0..1: p10 / mean / p90 of the director's per-node target), whether stems are needed, the lexicon words, focal characters, locales and choice / cg / interlude moments; energy / darkness rank the track against the others (0..1); curves = each listed scene's director target over its nodes ({n, at: node index, v: target}, peak per step, ≤ 32 steps). The DAW's TEMP TRACKS compose from it; the AUDIO DIRECTOR's PLAY AS SCENE drives the stems with the curves. See lore/_MUSIC_DIRECTION_PLAYBOOK.md.
